image.name: resilio-sync
image.description: [Resilio-sync](https://www.resilio.com/individuals/) (formerly BitTorrent Sync) uses the BitTorrent protocol to sync files and folders between all of your devices. There are both free and paid versions, this container supports both. There is an official sync image but we created this one as it supports user mapping to simplify permissions for volumes.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Jammy, migrate to s6v3.
Use upstream apt repo to install. Rebase to focal.
Deprecate `UMASK_SET` in favor of UMASK in baseimage, see above for more information.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Rebase to bionic, add pipeline logic and multi arch.
Use variable for arch to bring in line with armhf arch repo.
Rebase to ubuntu xenial, alpine linux no longer works with resilio.
Add variable for user defined umask.
Use fixed version instead of latest, while 2.5.0 is broken on non glibc (alpine).

volumes.desc: Where resilio-sync should store its config file.

image.title: Resilio-sync
image.setup_instructions:
* Webui is at `<your-ip>:8888`, for account creation and configuration.
* More info on setup at [Resilio Sync](https://www.resilio.com/individuals/)

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  resilio-sync:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/resilio-sync:latest
    container_name: resilio-sync
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/resilio-sync/config:/config
      - /path/to/downloads:/downloads
      - /path/to/data:/sync
    ports:
      - 8888:8888
      - 55555:55555
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=resilio-sync \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 8888:8888 \
  -p 55555:55555 \
  -v /path/to/resilio-sync/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/downloads:/downloads \
  -v /path/to/data:/sync \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/resilio-sync:latest
